# Aman Srivastava

> Founding Software Engineer at Fixit AI, building agentic AI systems, backend infrastructure, and security & observability tooling. B.Tech in Computer Science from Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT).

Aman's current focus is agentic AI workflows (LangChain, LangSmith), security monitoring agents, observability (Axiom), and backend systems on Kubernetes/AWS. He previously worked on LLM-based backend systems at AFFINSYS AI, contributed to the BioChatter open-source project at EMBL, and interned as a Machine Learning Intern at PW Skills.
